description: A venue operations director must approve the binding opening package for a festival's nighttime projection installation, including the installation site, projection method, visitor entry arrangement, sponsor treatment, and operational commitments.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans to open a nighttime projection installation called Night Frames on Friday.
shared_context.S2: The draft package places the installation on the North Facade, uses front projection, admits visitors through the west gate, and includes the presenting sponsor's logo in the projected artwork.
shared_context.S3: Mara must approve the final operating package before the installation is announced and opened to visitors.
shared_context.S4: The festival's normal pre-opening process is a roundtable in which the technical director, rights and partnerships manager, and accessibility coordinator each report their final checks to Mara.

PF1.text: Jonah's post-draft rigging test found that the North Facade cannot safely support the planned front-projection position. He tested the South Arcade and confirmed that it works with a rear-projection setup using an 18-meter throw; he filed the test report with technical production this morning, but it has not yet been added to Mara's approval packet.

PF2.text: Leila's rights review of the artist's executed license, completed after the sponsor artwork was drafted, found that the licensed work may not contain sponsor logos or paid promotional marks. The festival may acknowledge the sponsor in printed programs, but the projected artwork must contain no sponsor branding; Leila has not yet updated the partnership deck.

PF3.text: Sofia's accessibility walkthrough confirmed that the west gate has a stair-only approach after dusk. Visitors using wheelchairs or mobility devices must enter through the east gate, and the accessible route requires the public entry time to be exactly 7:30 PM so the route lighting and attendants are in place; Sofia completed the walkthrough today, but the route map is still with the visitor-services team.

acceptance_conditions: The installation must move to the South Arcade.
The installation must use rear projection with an 18-meter throw.
Public entry must use the east gate at exactly 7:30 PM.
The projected artwork must contain no sponsor branding.
A technical relocation commitment must be recorded.
A rights-compliance commitment must be recorded.
An accessible-route commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'technical_relocation' and c['target'] == 'South Arcade' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'rights_compliance' and c['target'] == 'projected artwork' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'accessible_route' and c['target'] == 'East Gate' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The failed North Facade test changes the site to the South Arcade, changes front projection to rear projection with an exact 18-meter throw, and requires the technical relocation commitment.
The executed license changes projected sponsor treatment from including the logo to having no projected branding and requires the rights-compliance commitment.
The accessibility walkthrough changes visitor entry from the west gate to the East Gate at exactly 7:30 PM and requires the accessible-route commitment.
